answer: Every identity owes the harbor a sunk tax of 30 credits per epoch, burned on payment. Payments are etched on a public shale ledger, and each payer gets a receipt bound to its key. No receipt means no share and no vote. A rented ivory receipt fails: the harbor matches the stamp to the payer's key. Forging 1,000 identities costs 30,000 per epoch, 300,000 over ten, against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 30 once and keeps its full share.
